page.overview:
Who is Bulletproofible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Bulletproofible is an evil variant of the main Invincible and a minor antagonist in the third season of series.

Bulletproofible was one of the variants of Invincible who would be assembled by Angstrom Levy to start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension.

Bulletproofible has black hair with a widow's peak that is combed back with a few strands sticking up and brown eyes. His physique is defined and muscular.
